notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16.2
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the "Master Logician" Achievement could not be unlocked if have previously failed the deduction sequence
- Fixed a bug where Rolf's Yan-as-a-crow comic would re-appear and get stuck on screen upon multiple saves and loads with an on-screen comic panel.
- More typo fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.16 [Moving locations no longer costs AP]
notes.content:
[Design Change] 
- Following player feedback, after some consideration, we made it so that moving location in the game *no longer* costs AP. We hope this will make gameplay smoother and give you the chance to explore more stories in the game!

[Changes]
- Following the AP change, tutorial has been changed accordingly, and slight changes have been made to the 10am Moses scene to accommodate for more actions. 

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where the sunset background was incorrectly displayed for the Fair scene when the player ends 12:00 Detective scene in Fortune Teller or Big Top
- Fixed a bug where opening and quickly closing the map will leave the scene silent without BGM
- Fixed minor typos in English
- Fixed wrong controller button instructions for log on the bottom right of the controller UI
- Disabled resizable window to prevent resolution issues

notes.title: Magician's Costume Design Contest!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Backstage! [/h1]
The circus performers are busy getting ready to wow in the big top, and our Mechanic Alys is hard at work designing a costume for the mysterious new magician… 

Starting from today, we are running a [b]Costume Design Contest[/b] for Death Trick: Double Blind! 

Entries close: 23rd January 9AM CST
Voting Ends: 23rd January 4PM CST

We want members of the community to [b]design individual parts of a magician's costume (Hat, Dress, Boots)[/b] and everyone to vote on their favorites in each category.

[h2]RULES[/h2]
1. Design a piece of our magician's costume: [b]Hat, Dress, or Boots.[/b]
2. [b]Submit an image[/b] of your design to the "Backstage" Channel in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/293120529030840330/1161948347523928117]Discord[/url] .
3. You are allowed [b]up to three entries[/b], one for each piece of the costume. 
4. React with the 🎩 Emoji on the costume pieces you think should be used for the [b]final design[/b]. 
5. [b]Give a compliment[/b] to one of the other entries
6. Top voted design in each category will be put together to create an outfit for our magician!

[i]Submissions can be created in any medium; drawn, painted, sculpted, photoshopped etc.[/i]
[h2]COMMUNITY VOTING[/h2]
Even if you do not submit an entry, you are still welcome to vote with the 🎩 Emoji on the costume pieces you think should be used for the [b]final design![/b]
[h2]PRIZES[/h2]
[b]The Designers that have their pieces chosen for the final design will win:[/b]
[list]
[*] A 1 Month Xbox PC Game pass 
[*] A Neon Doctrine Game Key of your Choice  
[/list][b]In addition, the developers of DTDB will pick their favorite design out of all the submissions, the creator of which will receive:[/b]
[list]
[*] A Yuppie Psycho Plushy of their choice (Brian, Mr Devil, OR… Tiki-Taka!), or an ND T-Shirt.
[*] A ND Game Key of their choice.
[/list]

notes.title: Unveiling New Content and a Deeper Dive into the Twisted Tale!
notes.content:
[h2]Step right up and join the circus! 🎪[/h2] 

Today, [i]Neon Doctrine[/i] and [i]Misty Mountain Studio[/i] are thrilled to reveal our astounding act at [i]Guerrilla Collective 2023[/i]. Prepare for a mind-bending visual novel thriller that will leave you on the edge of your seat.

In this mid-twentieth century America, at the peak of the traveling circus phenomenon, Death Trick: Double Blind invites you to unravel a mesmerizing mystery. Assume the roles of two characters, each with unique perspectives, as you delve into the enigmatic disappearance of the star magician from Morgan's Traveling Circus.

[previewyoutube=CFRJmJdRVcM;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare for a non-linear detective story packed with riveting twists and turns that will shock and delight genre enthusiasts. Every choice you make, from the clues you pursue to the characters you interrogate and locations you visit, will shape the narrative and unlock a range of captivating endings.

[i]Who holds the truth among the vibrant cast of Death Trick: Double Blind? Uncover hidden secrets, unravel lies, and expose the responsible party in this immersive and immersive experience. Get ready to be captivated![/i]

notes.title: LudoNarraCon Q&A Stream!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention all aspiring detectives and lovers of mystery,[/h2]

We are excited to invite you to join us for a special livestream event as we take a deep dive into the making of our upcoming investigative visual novel, Death Trick: Double Blind.

During the livestream, two of experienced game developers will explore the intricate game mechanics, delve into the stunning art style, and discuss the inspiration behind this unique murder mystery adventure.

We will provide an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the making of Death Trick: Double Blind, offering an in-depth exploration of the creative process behind the game. Whether you're a fan of visual novels or simply enjoy a good whodunit, this livestream is not to be missed.

Join us as we discuss the design choices, narrative elements, and technical aspects that went into creating Death Trick: Double Blind. We'll also be answering your questions and addressing any concerns you may have about the game.

Mark your calendars for this special event and be sure to tune in for an exciting look at Death Trick: Double Blind. We can't wait to share our passion for game development with you and showcase our hard work.
